title: OPS HERO crop configuration
description: Editable crop coordinates, asset selections, alignment anchors, native dimensions and source-board references. Values here ALWAYS win over automatic region detection.

validated.description: MUST be false until a human has compared the generated contact sheets against the source boards. Tools print a warning while this is false.

coordinate_space.description: pixels = rects are absolute source-board pixels. normalized = rects are fractions of board width/height (0..1), resolved to pixels once the real board dimensions are known. Draft configs written before the files exist MUST use 'normalized' or omit rects entirely.

boards.description: Keyed by logical source name (PROTAGONIST_SOURCE, ICONS_SOURCE, ...).

min_area.description: Connected components smaller than this (in source pixels) are discarded as noise.

merge_gap.description: Bounding boxes within this many pixels are merged, reattaching detached parts such as a raised hand, an antenna or a rotor tip.

chroma_policy.description: edge-connected: remove ONLY chroma regions touching a board boundary; interior mint is artwork and is preserved. edge-and-enclosed: also remove chroma fully enclosed by artwork. Required for hollow shapes such as the aura rings, whose interior must end up transparent. Opting in is audited: the pipeline reports how many interior pixels it removed.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in the file's declared coordinate_space.

alignment.description: foot-baseline: horizontally centred, alpha-bbox bottom pinned to the canvas bottom row, one shared baseline per family. airborne: same, lifted by a fixed constant applied identically to every airborne frame. center: alpha-bbox centre pinned to canvas centre. tile: scaled to exactly fill the tile cell. none: pasted at origin.

region.description: Region id in reading order from the detector, e.g. 'r0'. Reading order is rows top-to-bottom, then left-to-right within a row.

flip_h.description: Mirror horizontally. A deterministic transform, permitted so a source pose that faces the wrong way matches the family's canonical facing. It is NOT redrawing.

confidence.description: Honesty flag. Only a human who compared the contact sheet to the board may set 'visually_validated'.

panel.description: Output panel filename this region belongs to.

sample_at.description: Point inside the same panel whose 6x6 median colour becomes the cover fill. The fill is SAMPLED from the artwork, never invented.

reason.description: Why this region is dynamic, e.g. 'score value is rendered by Phaser'.

expected_regions.description: Region count the detector must find. A mismatch is a hard ERROR that requires overrides, never a silent guess.

overrides.description: region id -> rect. Replaces the detected bounding box outright.

outputs.description: Output filename -> its frame list and normalization rules.

native_frame.description: [width, height] of ONE frame in native game pixels.

frames.description: Ordered: index in this array becomes the frame index in the output spritesheet.

skip.description: Region ids that are documented redundant variants. Reported as SKIPPED with their bbox, never silently dropped.

clean_regions.description: HUD dynamic areas to cover before the frame becomes a template.

screen_interior.description: Region id -> rect of a baked robot/monitor screen. Stored so a later pass can replace baked text with pixel symbols without redoing crops. The MVP keeps the baked text.
